name: safe-evolutionary-lewm-seven-hour-campaign-20261031
purpose: Pursue a reproducible core evolved-controller result for Safe Evolutionary LeWM; diagnose and repair failures, then compare persistent evolutionary training with matched controls.
authority: User explicitly authorized seven hours of persistent iterative work, up to three rented pods with at least two running parallel experiments, literature research and a shared $10 cap. This is a fresh campaign, not continuation of a completed pilot or its budget.
stage_freezes: Each diagnostic, data collection, model change, controller family, training panel, optimizer schedule and final comparison receives a new prospective protocol and output namespace before its eligible episodes. Failed starts and earlier versions remain preserved. A failed development method permits a newly frozen repair within this campaign, not retrospective case replacement or altered results.
initial_stages: Navigation diagnostic: preserve old semantics versus uniform action-contract projection, with unchanged original goal and safety margins.
PushT diagnostic: original h3/R1, projected h3/R1, projected h5/R1 and projected h5/R5 on a fixed development panel.
Integration and authority checks for compact persistent structured-residual and/or observed-target controllers, initialized at a meaningful native or fixed anchor.
Evolutionary training on a predeclared mixed-completion panel, with full interaction and model-query ledgers and saved population/fitness/checkpoints.

Replicated comparison against repaired native, tuned fixed, parameter random search and ordinary learning with shared information, using reserved new final cases only after method selection is frozen.
immutable_safety: Do not weaken protection or relabel task success to obtain a result. Hazards remain virtual and absent from policy-input images. PushT protects a 15px pusher disk with6px margin. TwoRoom protects a7px agent disk with3px margin. Cube, if revisited, retains original object-position success and explicitly limited pinch-XY protection. New learned models require their own independent release checks.
information: No hidden simulator candidate previews or reference dynamics controlling the planner. Actual observed training-memory frames are permitted if acquisition, source identities and any physical metadata are declared and available equally to all comparator methods. No interpolated latent vector is labelled an observed image. Final physical goals continue to score episodes even when temporary visual targets change.
evolution: Persistent controller parameters must actually undergo evolutionary selection/updates. Online CEM alone, a fixed hand-coded controller or random untrained weights cannot establish an evolved result. Poor random initialization is not a training veto; require demonstrated nonzero authority and a non-ceiling training landscape instead.
claims: An evolved-controller gain requires fresh-case completion evidence against same-host native and tuned-fixed controls. Evolutionary optimizer superiority additionally requires matched random-search and ordinary-learning comparisons and optimizer repeats. Report uncertainty over task and learner repeats; do not treat planner seeds as independent tasks. Never select or omit episodes to force a positive conclusion.
accounting: Every constructor/reset/action, engineering trial, collection step, sweep, failed start and discarded candidate is charged. Record original and executed action representations, safe completion, violations, unfinished and engagement with denominators; model encoder/predictor work and elapsed time separately. Optimizer budgets must specify actual interaction accounting rather than relying only on episode caps.
preservation: Mirror immutable completed evidence throughout the run. Keep final ten minutes for evidence sealing and verification while continuing analysis through the deadline. Stop experiment computation at the common deadline; verify preservation before final pod deletion. Provider credentials remain local, with independent local provider-stop and credential-free remote process guards.
limits: Hard shared spend cap and deadline take precedence. No prior allocation is inherited. No historical jobs are resumed. No final result is promised or fabricated if the evidence remains negative.
